title: A race for the count
hints: Every task reads `shells` before any of them writes it back: a race.
`async with lock:` lets only one task at a time between reading and writing.
starter:
import asyncio

shells = 0

async def count_shell():
    global shells
    seen = shells
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    shells = seen + 1

async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(*[count_shell() for _ in range(8)])
    say(shells)

asyncio.run(main())

sk.title: Preteky o počet
hints: Každá úloha prečíta `shells` skôr, ako ho niektorá zapíše: preteky.
`async with lock:` pustí medzi čítanie a zápis len jednu úlohu naraz.
